'''Banna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] in the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ws" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="erc">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] began forming a [[Wraith Squadron|new X-wing squadron]] that would be as capable in [[Commando/Legends|commando]] missions on the ground as they were in a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. When recruiting for this [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], Antilles wanted candidates who were experienced pilots that no other commanders wanted; pilots known for causing trouble or making grave mistakes. Banna was one such pilot and agreed to try out for the squadron. A decent but not extraordinary slicer, Banna was caught slicing his test scores to improve them during the initial training and culling process for the candidates at the New Republic's [[Folor Base]] training facility, and he was removed from the program the next [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="ws" />

==Behind the scenes==
Banna was mentioned in the fifth novel of the [[Star Wars: X-Wing (novel series)|''X-wing'']] series, ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'', written by [[Aaron Allston]] and published in [[1998]].<ref name="ws" />
